title: TradingAgents: multi-agent LLM orchestration for strategy selection
applied_action: Added H165 QUEUED entry to hypothesis-log.md
summary: Explore TradingAgents (arXiv 2412.20138, GitHub: TauricResearch/TradingAgents) as an orchestration layer. The framework assigns LLM agents to roles (fundamentals analyst, news analyst, risk manager, portfolio manager). v0.2.4 supports Claude 4.x natively. Potential use: automate the hypothesis-selection step of the nightly dream cycle, or add a macro-regime awareness layer to H018.

source.paper: TradingAgents: Multi-Agents LLM Financial Trading Framework
source.version: v0.2.4 (April 2026) — supports GPT-5.x, Gemini 3.x, Claude 4.x, Grok 4.x

implementation.use_case_1: Nightly: run TradingAgents macro-regime analyst → output bullish/bearish/neutral → gates H018 ETF rotation (H026) between full risk-on and BIL safe haven
implementation.use_case_2: PEAD filter: run news-analyst agent on earnings release text before entering H159b position
implementation.requires: $OPENAI_API_KEY or Anthropic key (both present in vault)

expected_improvement: Regime awareness for H026/H018 — may reduce MaxDD during macro stress periods (COVID 2020, rate hike 2022) by getting to BIL faster than momentum signal alone.
risks: API costs per turn — nightly use is fine but intraday LLM calls add up
LLM is not statistically validated as a macro regime detector — adds noise risk
Benchmark first: does simple VIX threshold achieve same regime signal at 0 cost?
